subject: P12 Diamond Edition
author: Abernyte
body:
The car is indeed the reward for 500 challenges.

As for the car itself, I like it. I just wish they would stop putting finishes on the cars that you can't get rid off. The diamond pattern is definately not to my tastes.

subject: If you got it at the same
author: YabobK34
body:
If you got it at the same time as your 500th Challenge it probably is (unless it was for just the 10 of course).

 

Haven't played online yet as I want to unlock some more cars first (so I don't have to see people drive around in them before I have got them myself). Offline seems to progress slowly though (in terms of cars).... I have only 5 events left and the only car I have got this far is from the Dust Storm Burning Route. Still a lot of Smashes, Billboards, Jumps and Road Rules left though.

body:
You unlocked it but you're not sure how you unlock it? Hmmm...

Anyway, it's a bit "50 Cent" for my tastes. Prefer naked carbon fibre, myself.

subject: 500 challanges + P12 Diamond Edition
author: xenzonx
body: Yesterday is got my Burnout Paradise experience complete (burnout paradise 102%, bikes 101% and the island 100%), i think the island is great, but its still to small. when you did everything you can help your friends, i think doing the challenges online with a good team is a great way to play the game, my friendslist expand thanks to burnout paradise (great social community). The P12 Diamond has got great rims, but the car it self is an old model (not worth doing 500 challenges for), there is nothing special about it for my personal 800 hours of burnout paradise a disappointment. No, the most beautiful car with texture is the The Carson GT Tiger great rims. why not a custom pack where you can change parts of the car? we always want more.................and i think there will be !!! have fun !!!👍
